channel.title: Blog — Open Agent and AI Security Community
channel.description: Announcements, release notes, and project updates from the Open Agent and AI Security Community.

item.title: Community Spotlight: It's Time for Common-Sense AI Security
item.dc:creator: Open Agent and AI Security Community
item.description: Community member Steve Wilson makes the case that AI security doesn't need a new rulebook — it needs the same sandboxing, credential hygiene, and least-privilege discipline the industry already knows, actually applied to agents.

item.title: Community Spotlight: Connecting SAILORS to Praxen
item.dc:creator: Open Agent and AI Security Community
item.description: Community member Vinaya Vasu connects her SAILORS security framework to Praxen, showing how design-time checks and post-build verification reinforce each other.

item.title: Join Us on LinkedIn
item.dc:creator: Steve Wilson
item.description: Our LinkedIn community is live — join for release announcements, discussion, and news from the people building Observra and Praxen.

item.title: Community Spotlight: Mapping OWASP Risks with Praxen
item.dc:creator: Open Agent and AI Security Community
item.description: Community member Steve Wilson used Praxen to test 12 open-source agent projects against both the OWASP LLM and Agentic Top 10 — and found the two risk taxonomies overlap more than most people expect.
